name: Frame Timer (per-update counter)
description: Run an action every frame via the per-frame `update` script event (counters, thruster impulses, per-frame state).

key.description: Persistent variable key to increment each frame

notes: The `update` event fires once per frame on both runtimes and in headless simulation; the ScriptContext carries `dt`. Combine with incrementVariable for timers, or applyImpulse for continuous thrust.
